short.bowl: white bowl with red green pattern

global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Topped with shredded cabbage and green onions, it sits in a patterned bowl on a warm wooden table under soft, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm orange-brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red and green geometric patterns and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, pale brown slices with slightly uneven, moist surfaces and faint marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
